findings.title: SQL query built from dynamic string
findings.detail: Query text is built by string operations; use parameterised queries (placeholders '?' / '%s') instead.

findings.title: OS command execution through a shell
findings.code: output = subprocess.check_output("ping -c 1 " + host, shell=True, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=10)
findings.detail: shell=True passes the command to /bin/sh; metacharacters in user input (; | && $()) execute arbitrary commands.

findings.title: Unsafe deserialization
findings.owasp: A08:2021 Software and Data Integrity Failures
findings.detail: pickle.loads() can execute arbitrary code when given attacker-controlled data. Use JSON with schema validation.

findings.title: Hard-coded secret or credential
findings.detail: 'secret_key' is assigned a literal string; load it from the environment or a secrets manager instead.

findings.title: Hard-coded secret or credential
findings.detail: 'ADMIN_PASSWORD' is assigned a literal string; load it from the environment or a secrets manager instead.

findings.title: Autoescaping disabled in template (|safe / Markup)
findings.detail: The Jinja '|safe' filter disables auto-escaping; any user data rendered through it leads to Cross-Site Scripting.

findings.title: Weak hash algorithm (MD5/SHA1)
findings.detail: MD5/SHA-1 are fast and broken; for passwords use a slow, salted KDF (scrypt, Argon2, bcrypt, PBKDF2).

findings.title: File path built from user input
findings.detail: A file path is derived from user input; '../' or an absolute path escapes the intended directory. Use werkzeug.utils.secure_filename / safe_join and send_from_directory.

findings.title: Uploaded file saved with client-supplied name
findings.detail: The client controls file.filename ('../../app.py'); sanitise it with secure_filename, restrict extensions and size.

findings.title: Authorization decision based on client cookie
findings.detail: Cookies are fully controlled by the client; never trust them for authorisation. Use the server-side session / database.

findings.title: Flask debug mode enabled
findings.detail: The Werkzeug debugger allows remote code execution and leaks source code. Never enable it outside local development.

findings.title: Open redirect
findings.detail: Redirect target comes from the request; attackers can send victims to a phishing site. Allow only relative, same-site paths.

findings.title: Stack trace returned to the client
findings.detail: Internal stack traces leak file paths, code and library versions to attackers.

findings.title: Server bound to all interfaces
findings.detail: Listening on 0.0.0.0 exposes the app on every network interface; put it behind a reverse proxy.
